name: pi-image-core
description: Shared core for the pi-*-image extensions: upload persistence, the unified image-model override file + source tagging, retrying image-API fetch, model resolution, the per-backend model catalogs, and provider auth/key resolution. Extracted from pi-venice-image / pi-openrouter-image / pi-openai-codex-image / pi-local-image so the four extensions stop copy-pasting (and pi-local-image stops mirroring) the same plumbing.
